description: Scientists propose a self-interacting Dark Matter model in which particles collide and form dense cores. The theory could explain mysterious gravitational effects seen in galaxy lenses, stellar streams, and dwarf galaxies across the universe.
title: Scientists Reconsider Dark Matter Theory Amid Growing Cosmological Mysteries

description: Vivo X300 FE was launched in India recently with a Zeiss-tuned triple rear camera unit, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary sensor, and a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset. It has a 6,500mAh battery with both wired and wireless charging support. The new phone is designed to compete with the Xiaomi 17 and iPhone 17 in the Indian market. Here we compare their price and key specifications of the phones to help you decide which phone suits your needs.
title: Vivo X300 FE vs iPhone 17 vs Xiaomi 17: Price, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Google has been frequently updating its artificial intelligence (AI) tools in Search, namely AI Overviews and AI Mode. After releasing agentic capabilities and new features in the Google app for Windows and Chrome browser, the Mountain View-based tech giant has now introduced five more features focused on usability and ease of access.
title: Google Upgrades AI Mode, AI Overviews With Expert Advice and Link Previews

description: Pragmata has now sold over 2 million copies. Capcom announced Thursday that it's sci-fi action-adventure title had reached the sales milestone in 16 days of launch. The game, a new IP from Capcom, launched on PC, PS5, Xbox Series S/X, and Nintendo Switch 2 on April 17.
title: Pragmata Has Sold Over 2 Million Copies in 16 Days Since Launch, Capcom Announces

description: Google's Tensor G7 chipset is likely to debut with the Pixel 12 series next year. While we wait for the arrival of the Pixel 11 series this year, a leak has provided details about this chipset. The Tensor G7 chipset reportedly bears the codename “Lajolla” or “LaJolla.” The name could be a reference to the La Jolla region in San Diego. Google used California-related codenames for its previous Pixel phones.
title: Google Tensor G7 Chip's Codename, Key Details Revealed in New Leak; Expected to Debut With Pixel 12 Series in 2027

description: Google is revamping its health ecosystem with the launch of Google Health Coach and the transition from the Fitbit app to the new Google Health app. The updated platform adds AI-based wellness insights, redesigned fitness and sleep tools, and expanded health tracking features powered by Gemini models. Google said the rollout starts on May 19, while eligible users will receive access by May 26. The company has also confirmed Google Health Premium pricing in India and announced integration support for wearable devices, Apple Health, and Health Connect.
title: Google Health App Replaces Fitbit App as Company Brings Google Health Coach to India

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is believed to be one of the most expensive video games of all time. While Rockstar Games has not revealed the game's budget, analysts estimate that development costs range between $1 billion and $1.5 billion. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick, too, admitted the game was "expensive".
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Budget Estimated to Be Over $1 Billion, Take-Two CEO Says 'It Was Expensive'

description: The OTT platforms are ready to hit your digital screens with a fresh set of releases, including Lukkhe, Citadel S2, Dacoit, and more.
title: OTT Releases This Week (May 4 - May 10): Dacoit, Lukkhe, Citadel Season 2, Oh Butterfly, Love Insurance Kompany, and More

description: Love Is Blind Poland S1 brings emotional connections, romance and dramatic relationship journeys to Netflix through its unique pod dating experiment.
title: Love Is Blind Poland S1 Now Streaming Online: What You Need to Know About Polish Reality Show

description: Starring Sonakshi Sinha in the lead role, System is an upcoming Courtroom thriller film that is set to land on Prime Video soon.
title: System OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Sonakshi Sinha Starrer Courtroom Thriller Online?

description: Samsung says the Galaxy Watch 6 was able to identify warning signs linked to vasovagal syncope during clinical testing. The system reportedly analysed heart rate variability data collected through the smartwatch’s PPG sensor using an AI-based prediction model. According to the company, the study achieved 84.6 percent accuracy and could detect potential fainting episodes up to five minutes in advance. Samsung has not yet announced when the capability could arrive on consumer Galaxy Watch devices.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch Could Predict Fainting Up to Five Minutes in Advance, Study Shows

description: Redmi K100 will be launched with support for 50W wireless charging, a tipster claims. If this is true, then the handset will offer a notable upgrade over its predecessor, the Redmi K90, which only supports 100W wired fast charging and 22.5W wired reverse charging. On top of this, the rumoured Redmi K series smartphone will reportedly be equipped with a significantly larger 8,500mAh battery, as its predecessor is backed by a 7,100mAh battery. However, the company is said to be experimenting with larger cells, too.
title: Redmi K100 Tipped to Launch With Significant Battery Upgrade, Wireless Charging Support

description: Boat Nirvana Eutopia 2 Pro will be launched in India soon. The headphones, whose launch was confirmed at the Snapdragon for India event in New Delhi on Tuesday, will be powered by a Snapdragon chipset. While details remain under wraps, they are confirmed to feature active noise cancellation (ANC) and support hybrid connectivity. The Boat Nirvana Eutopia 2 Pro will also support Qualcomm’s Bluetooth Lossless Audio Technology, powered by the Snapdragon Sound platform.
title: Boat Nirvana Eutopia 2 Pro With Snapdragon Chip Teased at Snapdragon for India Event Ahead of Launch in India

description: iQOO has officially teased the iQOO 15T, iQOO Pad 6 Pro, and iQOO TWS 5i ahead of their China launch. Reservations for all three devices are now live in China alongside promotional offers for buyers. The iQOO 15T teaser reveals a flat-frame design and large rear camera module, while leaks hint at a Dimensity 9500 chipset, 144Hz display, and 8,000mAh battery. The Pad 6 Pro and TWS 5i are also expected to feature flagship specifications, large batteries, and gaming-focused features.
title: iQOO 15T, Pad 6 Pro and iQOO TWS 5i Posters Reveal Design as Company Opens Pre-Orders in China

description: Motorola Razr Fold will launch in India on May 13. A dedicated microsite on Flipkart and the Motorola India website are teasing the specifications of the new Motorola book-style foldable smartphone. It will be available in two colourways and two RAM and storage options in the country. It is already available in global markets with a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, 6,000mAh battery and a triple rear camera unit.
title: Motorola Razr Fold India Launch Date, Colourways and Memory Configurations Announced

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra and Find X9s will be available for purchase in India via two e-commerce platforms and the company’s website, the tech firm revealed on Thursday. The dedicated microsites on Flipkart, Amazon, and the Oppo India online store are now live, confirming their availability in the country via the three sites. The handsets are confirmed to be launched in India later this month. However, the exact date of arrival has yet to be revealed by the tech firm. This comes shortly after the two handsets were launched in select global markets.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra, Oppo Find X9s Availability Details Confirmed, Will Go on Sale via Amazon and Flipkart

description: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio has shared an in-depth look at its upcoming action-adventure title, Stranger Than Heaven, revealing details about the game's story, setting, main cast and characters, and a new combat system. Stranger Than Heaven will launch on PC, PS5, Xbox Series S/X, and Game Pass this winter.
title: Stranger Than Heaven Gets In-Depth Look at Story, Setting and Combat; Launch Set for This Winter

description: Apple is using a new internal stacking technique for its first book-style foldable to offer a relatively more repairable design, a tipster claims on Weibo. The Cupertino-based tech is reportedly employing a “reasonable and elegant" (translated from Chinese) internal stacking method, making its foldable display the “easiest” to disassemble and replace. The design is said to be free of “complex interconnected wiring”, to provide a modular design. The handset is expected to be launched later this year, along with the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.
title: Apple's iPhone Ultra to Feature Internal Design That Makes It the Most Repairable Foldable Yet, Tipster Claims

description: Acer Iconia iM11-22M5G has been launched in India with an 11.45-inch display with 2.2K resolution. It runs on a MediaTek 8791 processor, paired with 8GB RAM and 128GB onboard storage. It boasts a 16-megapixel rear camera unit and houses a 7,400mAh battery. The new tablet is priced at Rs. 25,499. You can buy it in a single Silver colour option through Acer exclusive stores, Acer online store, Amazon, and Flipkart.
title: Acer Iconia iM11-22M5G Launched in India With 11.45-Inch Display, MediaTek 8791 SoC: Price, Features

description: Realme 15x was launched in India in October last year. Now, Realme seems to be shifting its focus to the Realme 16x. Ahead of any official announcement, the unannounced Realme 16x has reportedly appeared on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) website. The listing indicates that the India launch of the handset is on the horizon. It is tipped to be released in Endurance Brown and Glory White colour options.
title: Realme 16x Reportedly Bags BIS Certification, India Launch Could Be on the Cards

description: JioThings, the Internet of Things (IoT) arm of Jio Platforms, has launched a new in-car accessory in India. Dubbed JioCarSync, it is designed to convert existing wired infotainment systems into wireless setups for users of both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The company says it eliminates the need for wired connections, while still retaining support for existing features like navigation, music streaming, calls, and voice commands.
title: JioCarSync Launched in India With Wireless Android Auto, CarPlay Connectivity for Vehicles

description: Google Chrome is rolling out approximate location sharing on Android, allowing users to share a general area instead of precise GPS coordinates with websites. The feature aims to improve privacy while keeping location-based services functional. Users can still enable precise location sharing for navigation, deliveries, and nearby searches. Google also plans to bring the feature to desktop platforms in the coming months. Additionally, the company is preparing new APIs that will let developers request approximate or precise location access depending on website requirements.
title: Google Chrome Updated With Support for Approximate Location Sharing on Android

description: Anthropic, the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) startup, announced a partnership with Elon Musk’s SpaceX on Wednesday. As part of the partnership, the Claude maker will get to access more than 300 megawatts of processing power, significantly boosting its existing compute capacity. As a result of this and other collaborations, Anthropic has also announced that it is doubling the five-hour rate limit for Claude Code.
title: Anthropic Announces AI Compute Partnership With SpaceX, Increases Claude Code Rate Limits

description: OnePlus Nord CE 6 has been launched in India as the tech firm’s latest addition to the lineup. The new OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite accompanies the handset. The two handsets are set to go on sale in the country soon via Amazon and the OnePlus India online store. While the Nord CE 6 is offered in three colour options, the Nord CE 6 Lite ships in two colourways. Moreover, the OnePlus Nord CE 6 is powered by a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset, paired with OnePlus’ Touch Reflex Chip. On the other hand, the Nord CE 6 Lite features a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Apex SoC.
title: OnePlus Nord CE 6, Nord CE 6 Lite Launched in India With 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Features

description: Euphoria Season 3 explores adulthood, addiction, and complex relationships with a darker narrative and strong performances.
title: Euphoria Season 3 OTT Release: Cast, Plot, Trailer, Where to Watch, and More

description: Will is a legal crime drama that highlights corruption in the justice system while showcasing a daughter’s fight to prove her father’s innocence.
title: Will Tamil Movie OTT Release: Where to Watch it Online?

description: Qualcomm launched two new Snapdragon chipsets at the Snapdragon for India event in New Delhi on Thursday. The Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 and Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 mobile platforms are aimed at powering mid-range and affordable smartphones. As per the company, both SoCs introduce a new technology called Snapdragon Smooth Motion UI, which is designed to deliver smoother navigation and app responsiveness.
title: Snapdragon 6 Gen 5, Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 Chipsets Launched at Qualcomm's Snapdragon for India Event

description: Apple on Wednesday launched its new clean energy and environmental initiatives in India, the Cupertino-based tech giant announced in a press release. As part of its new initiatives, the iPhone maker plans to invest Rs. 100 crore in the country to build renewable energy capacity. For its new green initiatives, the Tim Cook-led tech giant has partnered with the Mumbai-based renewable energy company CleanMax. Apple claims that this will help it achieve its carbon-neutral goals by 2030.
title: Apple to Invest Rs. 100 Crore in India as Part of Its Renewable Energy and Environmental Initiatives

description: Samsung is now reportedly planning to introduce the Galaxy Ring 2 sometime after early next year. The wearable was earlier rumoured to debut at the Galaxy Unpacked event in the latter half of this year, but Samsung is said to have changed this plan due to factors such as the pace of growth in the smart ring market and overall marketing strategy. The Samsung Galaxy Ring was launched in 2024 with a price tag of Rs. 38,999.
title: Samsung Galaxy Ring 2 Launch Timeline Leaked; Could Arrive With Upgraded Sensors, Improved Battery Life

description: Redmi has officially teased the launch of a new device in India, with Amazon India availability already confirmed through a dedicated microsite. The company has not revealed the official moniker or specifications yet, but teaser messages strongly focus on speed and performance. Both Xiaomi India and Amazon India microsites carry phrases hinting at a fast and responsive experience. The Amazon page also mentions “Redmi S,” though its meaning remains unclear. More details about the upcoming Redmi device are expected soon.
title: Redmi Teases Launch of Performance-Focused Device in India, Amazon Availability Confirmed

description: Apple has been rumoured to introduce the iPhone 18 series at “aggressive pricing”, despite the soaring component costs. While there is still considerable time before the handsets launch, a recent leak has shed light on the possible design of the iPhone 18 Pro. According to a report, CAD renders of the purported handset have surfaced, which reveal a noticeably smaller Dynamic Island. The move, if it comes to fruition, could finally mean that Face ID components could be moved under the display.
title: iPhone 18 Pro CAD Renders Reveal Smaller Dynamic Island, Identical Rear Camera Design

description: OnePlus’ future has been one of certainty. The company was first rumoured to be winding up operations, but ultimately ended up merging with Realme, another brand under Oppo’s umbrella. All this while, leaks about upcoming OnePlus smartphones haven’t stopped surfacing. According to a tipster, the OnePlus 16 will feature an upgraded 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera. It is tipped to be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC under the hood.
title: OnePlus 16 Specifications Tipped Again; to Get 200-Megapixel Camera, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC

description: Welcome to the season of Ultra smartphones, and the latest entry is from Vivo: its best yet, the X300 Ultra. Here are my first impressions.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra First Impressions
